description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

United States Cold Storage is seeking a Full Stack Java Developer to build performant, scalable, reliable, and testable software for its warehouse management systems. The role focuses on hands-on software development for mission-critical systems using Java and front-end technologies.
Entry-level Java software developer designing, coding, and testing applications

Responsibilities:
• Hands on participation in design, coding, and testing

Requirements:
• Full Stack Java Developer with experience building performant, scalable, reliable, and testable software for our warehouse management systems
• You are expected to be a hands-on developer who has built mission critical systems using Java and front-end technologies
• You should have demonstrable experience applying software design patterns to solve complex problems
• have worked within an Agile Scrum model
• Strong Core Java knowledge
• Hands on participation in design, coding, and testing
• Experience with various back-end micro-services frameworks (Spring)
• Experience with JavaScript as well as some front-end stacks such as Angular or React
• Experience working with test driven development
• Experience working within a continuous delivery framework
• Experience working in a SCRUM team
• Proven experience in Java and Web development technologies
• Knowledge of relational databases such as Oracle and SQL server and ORM technologies (Hibernate)
• Strong knowledge of JavaScript and popular JavaScript libraries (TypeScript and Angular, specifically)
• Working knowledge of REST frameworks
• Working experience with one or more web application servers
• Experience with Maven and Git
• Experience with Atlassian tools (Confluence, Jira)
• BS degree in Computer Science or a related subject

Preferred:
• Experience in Supply Chain Logistics is a plus
